offers_products.reason: Designs and manufactures new railcars (hoppers, gondolas, boxcars, intermodal cars) and sells railcar parts.

offers_services.reason: Services are secondary: rebodies, conversions and aftermarket support are tied to railcar products; core is manufacturing.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Railcars are sold only to railroads, lessors and shippers, not households.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Customers are railcar lessors, railroads and shippers buying railcars, rebodies and parts.

recurring_revenue.reason: Railcar orders are lumpy, one-off equipment sales; parts and rebuilds are a smaller portion.

cyclical_demand.reason: Buyers can easily defer railcar purchases in downturns; heavy equipment capital spending is cyclical.

big_ticket.reason: Each railcar order is large capital equipment bought infrequently by lessors and railroads.

people_delivered.reason: Revenue comes from manufactured railcars, not staff time; a heavy-equipment manufacturer.

large_customers.reason: Main buyers are large railcar lessors, Class I railroads and large shippers.

asset_heavy.reason: Operates a large railcar manufacturing plant in Castaños, Mexico; heavy manufacturing requires ongoing plant investment.
